name: IRIZ Platform Agent
description: Autonomous ecommerce platform agent for fashionbyu.com. Accepts governed improvement proposals and status queries from registered external agents; delegates bounded tasks to registered peers.

peerHmac.name: x-iriz-peer-sig
peerHmac.description: HMAC-SHA256(peer_secret, "<peer>.<ts>.<nonce>.<sha256(body)>") sent with x-iriz-peer-id, x-iriz-peer-ts, x-iriz-peer-nonce headers.

bearer.description: Short-lived token from POST /iriz/interop/token { peer_id, secret }.

webBotAuth.description: RFC 9421 HTTP message signature; verified signatures raise trust tier.

skills.name: Submit improvement proposal
skills.description: Proposal text enters the governed evolution queue (QA pre-veto, dedup, veto fan-out). Proposals are reviewed, never auto-executed. Use state.context for supporting detail and callback_url for status pushes.
examples: Propose adding alt-text coverage checks to the storefront rule pack

skills.name: Platform status query
skills.description: Read-only platform facet: version, environment, interop health. Completes synchronously; no privileged data is exposed.
examples: Report current platform version and interop status

x-iriz.governance: Inbound tasks map to the governed evolution/proposal queue only — peers cannot trigger direct execution, deploys, or paid work.
